column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Tamper protection
column8: Blocks local and script-based changes to Defender AV settings; leave ON; per-device exceptions via troubleshooting mode.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > EDR in block mode
column8: Lets EDR remediate malicious artifacts even when a third-party AV is primary.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Automatically resolve alerts
column8: AIR-remediated alerts close themselves; keep on unless metrics need manual closure.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Live response
column8: Remote shell sessions on onboarded devices; gate unsigned scripts separately; audit sessions.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Web content filtering
column8: Enables the category-blocking feature that demdewcf policies then configure.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Live response for servers
column8: Extends live response to server OS; pair with change control on production hosts.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Live response unsigned script execution
column8: Allows unsigned scripts in live response sessions; convenience vs integrity trade; keep off unless the library is signed nowhere.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Custom network indicators
column8: Required before IP/URL indicators can block; needs network protection in block mode on devices.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Allow or block file
column8: Enables file hash indicators to actively block and quarantine; requires Defender AV as primary with cloud protection.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Deception
column8: Plants decoy accounts/hosts/lures; high-fidelity alerts on any touch. Scope via deception rules after enabling.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Preview features
column8: Opts the tenant into pre-GA endpoint features; fine for pilot tenants; decide deliberately for prod.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Endpoint attack notifications
column8: Microsoft experts flag hands-on-keyboard attacks in your tenant; free signal; leave on.

column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Microsoft Intune connection
column8: Shares MDE risk with Intune for compliance and enables security settings management flows.

column4: Restrict correlation to scoped device groups
column7: Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > Restrict correlation to within scoped device groups
column8: Keeps incident correlation inside device-group RBAC scopes; for strict multi-team/MSSP separation only.

column7: Settings > Device discovery
column8: Standard mode actively probes for unmanaged devices; Basic only listens; set exclusions for fragile OT segments.

column7: Settings > Microsoft Defender XDR > Permissions and roles
column8: Flips authorization from per-product roles to unified XDR roles per workload; map existing roles first; test with a scoped account.

column7: Settings > Microsoft Defender XDR > Identities > Automated response exclusions
column8: Attack disruption contains users/devices mid-attack; exclude only accounts that must never be auto-contained (break-glass).

column7: Settings > Microsoft Defender XDR > Email notifications
column8: Incident and response-action mails by severity and device group; route to the queue humans watch.

column7: AV exclusions vs ASR exclusions vs indicators vs automation folders vs isolation rules
column8: Five different exclusion layers act at different stages; document which layer holds each entry and audit quarterly. Allow-indicators beat AV exclusions for visibility.

column7: Device groups > automation level column
column8: Full auto-remediates; Semi queues approvals in the Action center; None investigates only. Workstations belong on Full.

column7: Defender AV network protection + SmartScreen + web content filtering
column8: Network protection (block mode) powers custom network indicators and WCF; SmartScreen covers the browser; know which layer fired before tuning.

column7: Hunting > Custom detection rules
column8: Scheduled advanced-hunting queries that raise alerts with response actions; near-real-time frequencies exist; entity mapping matters.

column7: Settings > Identities > Directory service accounts
column8: gMSA accounts MDI uses to read AD and execute response actions (disable user); least-priv and rotation come free with gMSA.

column7: Cloud apps > Policies > Session policies
column8: Reverse-proxy controls inside SaaS sessions: block download/paste on unmanaged devices; pairs with a CA session grant.

column7: M365 admin > Setup > Priority accounts + Defender differentiated protection
column8: Tag VIP mailboxes for stricter heuristics and dedicated reporting; feed the same list to your alert triage.
